cli.help:
mareactl status [--json]                            disk and ledger status
mareactl add <folder>                               manage a folder (e.g. ...\checkpoints)
mareactl remove <folder>                            bring everything back and stop managing it
mareactl scan [--json]                              fingerprints, sources, classes, model inspection
mareactl models [--unused N|--rollback] [--json]    every model; --rollback: copies Ollama keeps only for going back
mareactl check <file|folder>... [--json]            check files or folders before loading them (no ledger needed)
mareactl watch [--no-rescue] [--json]               check public sources, rescue models at risk
mareactl free [--gb N|--all|--rollback] [--instant] --yes free space quickly (undoable)
mareactl undo                                       undo the last cleanup
mareactl plan [--gb N] [--json]                     what the tide would evaporate (touches nothing)
mareactl evaporate [--gb N] --yes                   evaporate according to the plan
mareactl restore <file>                             bring one file back now
mareactl replicate                                  copy unique files to the mirror (NAS)
mareactl restore-all --yes                          emergency exit: bring everything back, detach everything
mareactl journal [n] [--json]                       recent activity
mareactl agent                                      serve evaporated files without the app open
mareactl service install|uninstall                  Linux: install the agent as a service (with sudo)

Options: --json (versioned JSON document), --yes (confirm changes).
Environment: MAREA_READONLY=1 (refuse every change), MAREA_DATA, MAREA_LANG.
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 needs confirmation, 3 check before loading, 4 dangerous, 5 read-only, 64 usage.

ob.intro: Marea frees space without you losing anything. Three things to know before starting.
ob.none_found: No model folders found. You can add one by hand.
ob.point1: It fingerprints every model and compares it with Hugging Face, your NAS and the other files on disk. Without a certain source, the file stays where it is.
ob.point1_title: It knows where every file would come back from
ob.point2: An “evaporated” file stays in its folder with its name but takes 0 bytes. When a program opens it, Marea brings it back and checks its fingerprint.
ob.point3: The first scan only measures. You decide what to free, or turn on automatic cleanup. You can always bring everything back with one click.
ob.point3_title: It does nothing without your OK
